answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a prism that rotates unpredictably. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed basalt of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the onyx behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1s155.
